title: The page hooks know the page tool under every surface's name
why: A page writer whose page tool has another name can never clear the feedback Stop check, and its page writes skip the question checks.
source: Owner 19:56 CST Nov 11, relaying home triage's page item 164 block
note: Cause: hooks/shared_names.py:138 DATA_TOOL = "ArtifactData"; feedback_guard.py, guard.py, guard_merge.py and call_judge.py match only it. Local sessions use mcp__claude-artifacts__db_write, db_query, db_get and db_list (settings allow list, 20:06 CST), with no out_dir. Incidents: home triage wrote item 164 twice with n 164 and the Stop check still asked it to send the ruling to itself (owner 19:56 CST). Degen's coordinator read items 204, 208 and 209 back by db_query and hook 7 still refused, so sessions changed the item's kind to get past it (coordinator 21:03 CST). Ask: (1) DATA_TOOL becomes a set of names in shared_names.py, the one constant every hook reads; a db_query, db_get or db_list of `items` that names or returns n counts as the read-back. (2) The waiting/ export works without out_dir, or stops being a required path. Proof: red tests; a transcript with only a db_query read-back of n passes; one with no read-back still fails. Changes a guard's verdict: a lane with full review. Waits for the fan-out (coordinator 19:58 CST), first in line. Until then the owner's typed `override` clears one Stop. Also seen: home triage opened the page URL in a browser instead of the Artifact read the waiting-page skill names. See step cloud-artifactdata-allow.
